symbols.name: chirp value
symbols.meaning: The chirp value $\chi_p=\exp(-\pi i p^2/q)$ at an integer $p$, a unit complex number.
symbols.quote: Let $\chi_p=\exp(-\pi i p^2/q)$ be the chirp value at an integer $p$.

symbols.name: phase twist
symbols.meaning: The phase twist $\tau_p=\exp(\pi i p/q)$ at an integer $p$, a unit complex number with $\tau_{p+q}=-\tau_p$.
symbols.quote: Let $\tau_p=\exp(\pi i p/q)$ be the phase twist at an integer $p$, which satisfies $\tau_{p+q}=-\tau_p$.

symbols.name: twisted first sequence
symbols.meaning: The sequence $\mu_j=u_j\chi_j\tau_j$ indexed by $j$, the first input of the cyclic convolution.
symbols.quote: The twisted sequences are $\mu_j=u_j\chi_j\tau_j$ and $\nu_p=\overline{\chi_p}\,\tau_p$ for $0\le j,p<q$.

symbols.name: twisted second sequence
symbols.meaning: The sequence $\nu_p=\overline{\chi_p}\,\tau_p$ indexed by $p$, the second input of the cyclic convolution.
symbols.quote: The twisted sequences are $\mu_j=u_j\chi_j\tau_j$ and $\nu_p=\overline{\chi_p}\,\tau_p$ for $0\le j,p<q$.

relations.quote: Bluestein's chirp identity rewrites the [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) of a vector and computes it by a [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) placed between two pointwise multiplications.

Bluestein's chirp identity rewrites the [discrete Fourier transform](fourier-transform.md) of a vector and computes it by a [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) placed between two pointwise multiplications.
Bluestein's chirp identity acts on the middle transform of the paper's multiplication algorithm, including its [target permutation](gaussian-resampling.md).
